integrity: The results are derived analytically with independent finite-state numerical corroboration. This is not an independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite N only for asymptotic error terms; positive rates; pair annihilation on complete graph; no uniqueness of the general odd crossing or all-rate even-size sign theorem; possible unindexed coverage.
title: Parity-dependent correlation reversal in fully refilled annihilating complete graphs
